integrity: The exact random-update equations are deduced from the original SAGA algorithm. A positive-definite quadratic and its exact conditional drift furnish both subcritical convergence and supercritical nonconvergence. A standalone exact-rational polynomial-identity checker corroborates the critical algebra; finite testing is not substituted for the analytic proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact necessary and sufficient mean-square convergence for the nonproximal uniform-index SAGA method with two identical one-dimensional positive-curvature quadratic component functions and arbitrary deterministic cached points. No claim for almost-sure stability at or beyond the cutoff, nonquadratic/nonidentical functions, nonuniform sampling, more components, minibatches, or proximal variants.
title: Exact mean-square stability cutoff for two-component SAGA on identical quadratics
